newsitem.title: USA: NorAm Gaming hires financial adviser.
newsitem.headline: NorAm Gaming hires financial adviser.

text.p: NorAm Gaming and Entertainment Corp said Thursday it has hired Rickel and Associates as its non-exclusive financial advisor, investment banker and consultant.

NorAm said that Rickel will furnish it with ongoing advisory and management consulting services, including corporate planning, oversight of operations, definition and development of business opportunities and the raising of additional capital.
